notes: Trail shoes, no spikes. Hard off-road effort, not a race. One of the three XC fixtures needed to complete the league.

name: Guy Fawkes 5
notes: 5 miles, and the first real race after Cheltenham. Clean run-in now the 31 Oct XC is off — nothing hard in the seven days before it. Club record is 29:12; current fitness (Riegel off both the 5K and 10K, which agree almost exactly) projects ~29:40 — about 28s/1.6% short, not banked. Worth revisiting once Cheltenham gives a fresher fitness read, but the Oct block between the two (Crete 10K fun run, 18 Oct XC as a hard off-road effort) isn't currently built as a sharpening block for this.

name: Cross country
notes: Trail shoes. Sits in base / early marathon build — no conflict. One of the three XC fixtures needed to complete the league.

name: Boddington 10
notes: Club record up for grabs at 1:01:00. Course confirmed flat, so the Riegel assumption holds without a downward adjustment: current fitness (Jun/Jul 2026 races) puts a flat, well-paced 10 miles at roughly 61:10-62:00 — right on the current fitness line, not banked. Falls mid-way through the Manchester base-build, so needs a short taper built into that block rather than being run off unbroken loading.

name: Cross country
notes: Trail shoes. Seven weeks out from Manchester (18 Apr), inside the marathon build. The third of the three XC fixtures needed to complete the league.

name: Manchester Marathon
notes: Goal sub-3 (4:16/km). Volume, not fitness, is the binding constraint.
